claude: Often preferred to ChatGPT for accuracy; usage limits are the gripe.
enpass: Local or own-cloud data with a lifetime option; bugs worry some.
gemini: Strong image tools and a generous free plan; some confident errors.
keepassxc: Local, private and subscription-free; syncing is manual.
keeper: Easy and reliable for teams; the price and upsells split opinion.
mullvad-vpn: Flat price, no email signup; streaming sites and Reddit block it.
nordpass: Clean, easy and reliable; the extension asks to unlock often.
proton-pass: Email aliases and a usable free plan; folders are missing.
windscribe: Good value with split tunnelling and ad blocking; Proton is faster.
